candidates.source_claim: For the complex Hopf bundle S¹→S^(2n+1)→CPⁿ, the integral cohomological Serre spectral sequence has d₂(u)=x, with H*(CPⁿ;Z)=Z[x]/(x^(n+1)) and |x|=2; the sign of x is fixed by u.
candidates.diagram_kind: E₂-page table and transgression for the complex Hopf fibration
candidates.why_warranted: A compact two-row table makes the bidegrees and the full finite string of d₂ maps legible, including the top-row class whose target lies beyond the base. This is an optional communication aid; the source gives the calculation in prose and no proof depends on a diagram.
concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Label the entry at (p,q) by E₂^{p,q}=H^p(CPⁿ;H^q(S¹;Z)); show only q=0,1 and p=0,2,…,2n, with each listed group Z and all other positions zero.
Draw d₂ arrows of bidegree (+2,−1), from (2k,1) to (2k+2,0) for 0≤k<n. Label the first generator arrow d₂(u)=x; multiplicativity gives d₂(ux^k)=x^(k+1). These arrows are isomorphisms.
At (2n,1), show uxⁿ with no outgoing arrow because the target column 2n+2 is outside the base; mark it as the surviving top class. Show the bottom-row unit at (0,0) surviving.
Indicate that the E∞ survivors give H⁰(S^(2n+1);Z)=Z and H^(2n+1)(S^(2n+1);Z)=Z, with other total cohomology zero; convergence is to the cohomology of the total space.
State the orientation/sign convention beside the table: choosing u fixes x=d₂(u); replacing u by −u replaces x by −x. Do not assign an absolute sign to x independently of u.
correctness_checks: Use cohomological Serre indexing d_r:E_r^{p,q}→E_r^{p+r,q−r+1}; in particular d₂ raises p by 2 and lowers q by 1.
Include all even columns through 2n and no columns beyond 2n; only the q=1 entries with p<2n have nonzero targets.
Check d₂(ux^k)=x^(k+1) for 0≤k<n and x^(n+1)=0; no d₂ arrow exits (2n,1).
After d₂, only (0,0) and (2n,1) survive, in total degrees 0 and 2n+1, matching convergence to the sphere.
The chosen u fixes the sign of x. Do not suggest a canonical positive sign without an additional orientation convention.
candidates.why_not_confirmed: No mathematical error was found. The proposed E₂-page diagram is optional; it clarifies indexing, truncation, and convergence without supplying a proof.
